---
title: "uv-python multi-format figure artifacts"
engine: uv-python
format:
  html: default
  gfm: default
execute:
  echo: false
  output: true
---

This fixture renders more than one format in a single command so figure files
created for one output format must not be deleted by the later format render.

```{python}
#| fig-cap: Multi-format uv-python figure
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2, 3], [3, 2, 1])
_ = ax.set_title("Multi-format figure")
```
